description.text: Why study in DUFE 1．Brought up a huge number of international students from over 100 countries. 2．Located in west of Xinghai Park in Dalian city, which is a famous national scenic site. 3．DUFE emphasizes a students-centered educational approach. 4．Good climate with distinctively four seasons. 5．Convenient traffic. 6．A nationally designated Business Chinese Test center and a test center for the Chinese 7．Proficiency Test(HSK) Program Introduction The programme will prepare you to become an international manager by developing your ability to think strategically, to communicate effectively and to implement complex business projects, ranging from new product development to mergers and acquisitions. Throughout the course you will be required to apply your new knowledge and understanding of relevant theories to a variety of business case studies. Teaching Objective To provide students with the opportunity to develop a strategic business outlook and to enhance their business and personal skills in a global context. Main Courses Include International Trade Theory and Policies Research, China’s Foreign Trade , Multinational Corporations and International Investment , etc. Fee Structure Tuition fee: 58500RMB/year Internship Students will have the opportunities to be engaged in industrial collaborative projects, interview techniques, resume instructions and review, visits to companies, and career consultation. Duration 2.5 Years Degree Awarded Master of Economic Future Career After graduation, graduate will be able to work in various areas such as multinational corporations, financial institutions, government agencies, or academic organizations. Teaching Facilities Teaching materials are chosen from popular textbooks and cases used in American and European economics and business schools and are combined with the practice of Chinese business techniques. Teacher Highlight Faculty members have a diverse background and most of them have been trained at some of the most prestigious academic institutions in the world and have impressive lists of publications and academic achievements.

duration.text: The MSc International Trade and Chinese Studies at Dongbei University of Finance and Economics is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 185 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 9166 USD/per year ￥ 66000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of undergraduate school 5.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6.Certificate of English proficiency test IELTS or TOEFl will only be required if the applicant is not a native English speaker. You can click here to download the sample

requirements.text: 1.Successful completion of Undergraduate degree with good grades; 2.IELTS 5.5 or equivalent, with no specific band requirement; 3. From 18 to 50 years old 4. Cover letter in English
